purpose: Portable aggregate of the completed 13-16 October final-candidate studies. Original local manifests and numerical outcomes are unchanged. Large generated artifacts are excluded from Git.
selection_reason: Current project reference in the 14 October feedback and all subsequent feedback through 16 October. It ties the earlier combined18_24_l2_1 at displayed F1 0.455 and has displayed accuracy 0.883 rather than 0.882. Rounding prevents inferring an exact F1 improvement, and the official leaderboard tie-break was not verified.

protocol.threshold_selection: Maximise F1 on pooled full-training OOF probabilities; break F1 ties by accuracy.
protocol.fit_scope: Preprocessing, imputation and model fitting use only the training rows of each OOF fit. The final model uses every labelled row.
protocol.calibration_warning: The same pooled OOF labels select and describe each threshold; calibration F1 is not an independent or nested estimate.
protocol.leaderboard_warning: Scores are user-reported display values rounded to three decimals, without submission URLs or independent retrieval. Repeated leaderboard feedback contributed to selection.
protocol.nested_warning: These 17 full-training candidates have no nested evaluation recorded for their exact full-training calibration runs. Earlier separate Phase 18/24/25 nested studies are preserved in the historical ledger.
